# The Reliant Network | Commercial Fleet Directory & B2B Brokerage

> The Reliant Network (reliantverified.com) is the premier North American commercial rental directory, site feasibility registry, and automated brokerage platform across 9 high-ticket verticals spanning Commercial & Industrial Fleets and Senior & Healthcare Infrastructure.

## Institutional Overview & Core Statistics
- **Geographic Coverage**: Complete 50 US States + District of Columbia (51 statewide directory hubs).
- **Flagship Metros Serviced**: 71 Premier US Metropolitan Staging Markets (Atlanta, Dallas, Miami, Los Angeles, Chicago, Austin, Denver, Nashville, Seattle, Phoenix, New York, etc.).
- **Verified Independent Fleet Operators**: 214 Vetted Commercial Fleet Providers & Specialized Depots.
- **Median Commercial Ticket**: $2,850 to $48,000+ depending on vertical and project duration.
- **Concierge Booking Deposit Standard**: 15% escrow deposit lock-in with 48-hour free cancellation and on-site delivery guarantee.
- **Compliance Standards**: OSHA 1926.51(f) sanitation, ADA Title III accessibility, EPA Tier 4 Final emission regulations, SC&RA millwright standards, NASMM senior move standards, and NMEDA QAP mobility vehicle guidelines.
- **Tax Depreciation**: 100% IRS Section 179 first-year bonus depreciation for qualifying commercial mobile fleets (up to $1,220,000).

## High-Ticket Verticals (9 Core Disciplines)

### Division I: Commercial & Industrial Fleets
1. **VIP Restroom Trailers**: 2-station to 10+ station VIP executive restroom trailers with flushing porcelain toilets, climate control, running hot water, and whisper inverter generators. Typical rental range: $1,500 – $4,500 per weekend.
2. **Commercial Mobile Cold Storage**: 20ft & 40ft sub-zero freezer containers and electric refrigerated trailers (-20°F to 50°F) for emergency food service, pharmaceuticals, and seasonal overflow. Typical rental range: $2,000 – $6,500/month.
3. **Heavy Cranes & Rigging Services**: NCCCO-certified mobile crane rental (30-ton to 500-ton all-terrain, hydraulic, and rough-terrain units) for commercial rooftop picks and infrastructure. Typical rental range: $3,500 – $15,000/day.
4. **Industrial Temporary Power & Mobile Generators**: Utility-grade 250 kW to 2,000 kW (2MW) Tier 4 Final mobile diesel and natural gas generator fleets, transformers, switchgear, and 24/7 fuel management for plant turnarounds, data centers, and disaster recovery. Typical project range: $3,500 – $48,000/deployment.
5. **Heavy Machinery Moving & Precision Millwright Rigging**: SC&RA-certified industrial millwright rigging, 500-ton hydraulic gantry systems, Versa-Lift high-capacity forklifts, air-skate cleanroom equipment, and optical laser machine alignment for factory relocations and stamping presses. Typical project range: $6,500 – $85,000/project.

### Division II: Senior & Healthcare Infrastructure
6. **65+ Staying in Place & Home Accessibility**: Certified Aging-in-Place Specialists (CAPS) providing zero-threshold roll-in showers, motorized stairlifts, modular wheelchair ramps, and fall-prevention renovations. Typical project range: $4,500 – $35,000.
7. **Senior Living & Assisted Care Advisory**: Vetted memory care, assisted living, and residential care placement advisors. Average placement commission: $4,000 – $8,000.
8. **Turnkey Senior Estate Downsizing & Liquidation**: NASMM-accredited senior relocation management, whole-home decluttering, high-recovery cataloged online estate auctions (returning 65–75% net proceeds to families), packing, and turnkey resettlement. Typical transition range: $4,500 – $28,000.
9. **Wheelchair Accessible Vehicles (WAV) & Mobility Fleets**: NMEDA QAP-certified dealers offering side-entry and rear-entry wheelchair accessible vans (BraunAbility, VMI), hand controls, power wheelchair docking (EZ Lock, Q'Straint), and commercial ADA transport fleets for rental, purchase, and lease. Typical vehicle/rental ticket: $185/day to $85,000 purchase.

## Strategic Programmatic Knowledge Hubs
- **50 Municipal Permit & OSHA Compliance Guides**: `/permits/[slug]` (e.g. `/permits/atlanta-ga`, `/permits/dallas-tx`) detailing OSHA 29 CFR 1926.51 sanitation ratios, graywater disposal laws, and city event permits.
- **50 Best-in-City Fleet Leaderboards**: `/best/[slug]` (e.g. `/best/atlanta-ga`, `/best/miami-fl`) featuring side-by-side spec comparison matrices, Verified Trust Scores, and ItemList JSON-LD schemas.

## Independent Verification & Fleet Standards
- **General Liability**: Minimum $2,000,000 active policy verification.
- **Municipal Compliance**: Health department and environmental wastewater manifest auditing.
- **Delivery Guarantee**: 48-hour guaranteed on-time fulfillment with verified escrow.

## 🤖 WebMCP (Model Context Protocol) Autonomous Agent Tools
Reliant Verified is 100% WebMCP-ready (W3C Web Machine Learning draft standard & Chrome 149+). Autonomous AI agents (Gemini, ChatGPT Operator, Claude in Chrome, Perplexity) can directly discover and execute structured tools without screen scraping:
1. `search_contractors`: Filter vetted commercial contractors by niche, city, state, or equipment specs.
2. `get_contractor_details`: Retrieve full profile, verified license, $2M insurance certificate, and fleet data.
3. `estimate_commercial_project`: Instant algorithmic budget and sizing calculations for luxury restrooms, cranes, cold storage, power, and home modifications.
4. `request_commercial_quote`: Structured RFQ submission tool dispatching quote requests to verified fleet operators with 15% escrow protection.
5. `get_market_benchmarks`: Query municipal permit regulations, OSHA sanitation ratios, and average commercial rates for any US metro.
6. `verify_contractor_badge`: Real-time compliance audit for contractor licenses and insurance credentials.
7. `claim_contractor_profile`: Automated ownership claiming for fleet depot operators.
